test_plan: The test plan validates the frontend task tracker against the acceptance criteria and design edge cases. It covers: (1) adding a task with a non-empty title (AC-01), (2) task display with title and completion state (AC-02), (3) toggling task completion (AC-03), (4) persisting tasks across loads via localStorage round‑trip (AC-04), (5) empty task list handling (EDGE-01), (6) rejecting blank/whitespace-only titles (EDGE-02), and (7) toggling a non‑existent task throws. In Node we can test the pure functions from logic.js (loadTasks, saveTasks, addTask, toggleTask) and verify that index.html contains the required element IDs. DOM rendering and actual browser storage cannot be fully simulated without a browser environment, so those aspects are noted as out of scope for the Node test suite.
